description: Builds a harmonic or subharmonic partial above a root pitch, or quantizes an incoming pitch to the nearest partial of that root

params.text: Selects the partial number, 1 being the fundamental and 16 four octaves above it; negative numbers give subharmonics
Picks which partials are available: A for all of them, O for odd ones, E for even ones plus the fundamental
Attenuates and inverts the CV input before it shifts the partial number
Detunes the output away from the exact partial, none at noon, flat to the left and sharp to the right
Sets how much the detune shrinks as pitch rises; fully counter-clockwise holds the detune constant, fully clockwise halves it every octave so the beat rate stays even, and that is where it starts

inputs.text: Shifts the selected partial by one for every 0.1V, clamped to the active partial range
The fundamental pitch that the partials are counted from, the first partial
A pitch patched here is quantized to the nearest partial or subharmonic of ROOT, within seven octaves either way, and the Partial and CV controls are then ignored

outputs.text: The chosen partial as a pitch, the root plus the interval of that partial

menu: Partial Range — the span of the Partial knob: 1 to 16 by default, out to 1 to 128, or -16 to 1 down to -128 to 1, or the symmetric -16 to 16 out to -128 to 128
Monitor channel — which polyphonic channel the numeric display reads, 1 to 16, or Off; channel 1 by default
